versions.title: Coin Packs
versions.summary: Change how every coin looks: wear Neon, Candy or Planets, or paint your own.
versions.intro: Coin Packs are in the settings, under Shaders. A pack redraws every coin from Copper to Eternity. Three come with the game, and you can paint your own, heads and tails, on a canvas up to 128 pixels across.

sections.title: New
items: Coin Packs|Wear one pack at a time to change how every coin looks, or keep the normal coins.
Neon, Candy, Planets|Three packs made with the game, every coin redrawn, every tails with a star.
Make your own|Paint every coin's heads and tails over a faint copy of the real one, then wear it.
Painting tools|Pencil, eraser, bucket, picker, line, box, circle, X / Y / diagonal symmetry, undo, and copy heads onto tails.

sections.title: Improved
items: 3D pack and Smooth|Pack coins flip with the physics tosses and show on Smooth too.

versions.title: The Floor
versions.summary: Open side tables that feed your main table, from Silver to Eternity.
versions.intro: Once your table reaches Silver, The Floor opens: side tables that are small games of their own. Pick each one's rule, sit down to play it, and every side table multiplies what your main table pays.

sections.title: New
items: The Floor|Up to five side tables, opening at Silver, Diamond, Pearl, Infinity and Eternity.
Table rules|High Roller, Speed, Lucky, Golden or Crowd: each table plays differently.
Feeding|Every side table multiplies your main table's pay, more as it grows.
Cash In|Start a side table over for stars that make it feed more, forever.

sections.title: Improved
items: Background|Tables with an auto-flipper keep earning while you're at another one.
3D pack|Coins come to rest turned however they landed.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Shader packs|Cozy, Retro, Cinematic and Time of day keep showing under menus and on the title screen (never over the UI).

versions.title: Patch 1.12.3
versions.summary: Stronger struck coins and melting, shader packs off the UI, and a counter that never sticks.
versions.intro: Stronger struck coins and melting, shader packs off the UI, and a counter that never sticks.

sections.title: Improved
items: The Mint|Struck coins are a big boost now: Gilded pays up to x150, Lucky raises every coin's pay, jackpots pay x500.
Melting|More stamps, and many stars are stronger again (about half of the 1.12.0 nerf undone).
After Infinity|The tiers after Infinity cost more, so The Mint has a stretch of its own.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Shader packs|Cozy, Retro, Cinematic and Time of day only change the table: the UI stays sharp.
Money counter|No longer gets stuck half-rolled past 1SX, and shows huge amounts short.
Money sparks|The little coins flying to your money pass under it.

versions.title: Patch 1.12.2
versions.summary: Six save slots, a calmer Cinematic camera, and short huge money.
versions.intro: Six save slots, a calmer Cinematic camera, and short huge money.

sections.title: Improved
items: Save slots|Six save slots instead of three (all in a row in a wide window, three at a time with tabs in a small one).

sections.title: Fixed
items: Cinematic|The camera moves gently on big tables: a few pixels of sway, and a small lean into waves only.
Money|Huge amounts of money show short (up to VG, then 1.23E66) instead of a long row of digits.

versions.title: Patch 1.12.1
versions.summary: Fixes for Cozy's dust, struck coin flips and tier-up lag.
versions.intro: Fixes for Cozy's dust, struck coin flips and tier-up lag.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Cozy|The dust no longer turns into big squares when the table is zoomed in, and no dust or blur shows over menus and panels.
Struck coins|They flip like any other coin (with the physics toss when the 3D pack is on) instead of ballooning.
Tier-ups|No more lag spike on tier-ups in the late game with the 3D pack on.

versions.title: The Mint
versions.summary: Strike coins of your own past Infinity, and four new shader packs.
versions.intro: Past Infinity, melting also gives bars of the metal you melted at. Strike them into your own coins: a little bigger than the rest, with their own design and 1 to 3 traits. They sit in the middle of the table and stay through every melt. There are also four new shader packs to mix with Shiny, Smooth and 3D.

sections.title: New
items: The Mint|Strike a bar into a coin at the press: pick a metal and a stamp (crown, eye, star or hourglass).
Struck coins|Up to 7 sit in the middle of the table, roll traits, and can be melted back into a bar.
Shader packs|Cozy, Retro, Cinematic and Time of day. Packs that change the same thing can't be on together.

sections.title: Improved
items: Balance|Melting gives fewer stamps, many stars are weaker, less carries into each run, and tiers past Diamond and the helpers cost less.
Auto-Flipper stars|At most 3 coins at once, with smaller pay and speed bonuses.
Helpers|Helper coins in the tray are twice as big.
First look|New players start with the Shiny and 3D packs on.
Removed|The Table Leaf helper (and the coins in its spots) and the Clockwork upgrade.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Less lag|The late game runs smoother with Shiny and the 3D pack on.
The Mint|Long trait lists no longer run under the MELT button.

versions.title: First Release
versions.summary: Flip coins, climb thirty tiers to Eternity, and race the world on the speedrun leaderboards.
versions.intro: Coin Flip comes to the Firefly Launcher. Start with one copper coin, fill the table, and climb through thirty coin tiers to Eternity. Melt down for Mint Stamps and light a hundred stars, then race everyone on the speedrun leaderboards.

sections.title: New
items: Speedrun leaderboards|Race to Gold, Diamond, Obsidian and Infinity against everyone, with a celebration for a top 10 finish.
Updates panel|Every update and patch is on the title screen, with a picture of each update.

sections.title: Improved
items: Saves|Your saves are backed up every 10 minutes of play, and an older version never overwrites a newer save.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Smooth|The felt no longer fades to black around the table or on the title screen.
